papers.title: SparDA: Sparse Decoupled Attention for Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference
papers.what: Adds a fourth Forecast projection to predict next-layer KV block needs, enabling lookahead prefetch for 1.7x decode speedup and 5.3x throughput on a single GPU.

papers.title: Agent Planning Benchmark: A Diagnostic Framework for Planning Capabilities in LLM Agents
papers.what: 4,209-case benchmark isolating planning failures from execution failures across 22 domains and five robustness settings.

papers.title: Compress-Distill: Reasoning Trace Compression for Efficient Knowledge Distillation
papers.what: Compresses CoT traces to 8-21% length before KD; 96% accuracy retained at 18x per-token efficiency, outperforming naive truncation.

papers.title: Ultralytics YOLO26: Unified Real-Time End-to-End Vision Models
papers.what: NMS-free real-time detector with MuSGD optimizer from LLM training and STAL label assignment for small objects; 40.9-57.5 mAP at 1.7-11.8 ms.
